title: Velocity at S
description: Essential: Correctly states the initial velocity magnitude as v = qBL/m.

title: Electric Field Strength
description: Essential: Correctly states the electric field magnitude as E = qB²L/m.

title: Force Balance Reasoning
description: Important: Applies the condition for straight-line motion in crossed fields (qE = qvB) to relate E and v.

title: Post-Plate Velocity Vector
description: Important: Correctly calculates the speed (√2 * qBL/m) and entry angle (45°) into the magnetic field after the plates.

title: Magnetic Trajectory Geometry
description: Important: Uses geometry of the circular path (radius √2 L) and the square boundary to find the exit point along side bc.

title: Exit Position and Direction
description: Essential: Correctly states the exit point is on side bc, a distance √2 L from b, moving vertically downward.

title: Sign/Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of the electric field or the final exit velocity for the negative charge.

title: Kinematics in Plates
description: Optional: Shows correct use of kinematics (L = vt, y = L/2) to find the vertical velocity component.
